dialogues.jp: 音夢を諦める。
dialogues.en: To forget about Nemu.
dialogues.text: To forget about Nemu.

dialogues.jp: それが正しい選択肢だろう。
dialogues.en: That would be the right choice.
dialogues.text: That would be the right choice.

dialogues.jp: 本当にあいつの幸せを考えるのなら。
dialogues.en: If I really thought about her happiness.
dialogues.text: If I really thought about her happiness.

dialogues.jp: 忘れてやるべきだ。
dialogues.en: I should forget about her.
dialogues.text: I should forget about her.

dialogues.jp:
すでに卒業式も入学式も迎えられず、血を吐く
ような想いをしたのだ。
dialogues.en:
She missed the graduation and the entering ceremony, and she
felt so bad about it already.
dialogues.text:
She missed the graduation and the entering ceremony, and she
felt so bad about it already.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の本当の気持ちを俺は覚えている。
dialogues.en: I remember how Nemu really felt.
dialogues.text: I remember how Nemu really felt.

dialogues.jp: 胸の高鳴りも。
dialogues.en: The throbbing of her heart.
dialogues.text: The throbbing of her heart.

dialogues.jp: ぬくもりも。
dialogues.en: Her warmth.
dialogues.text: Her warmth.

dialogues.jp: 唇の柔らかさも。
dialogues.en: The softness of her lips.
dialogues.text: The softness of her lips.

dialogues.jp: 澄んだ心まで。
dialogues.en: Her clear heart.
dialogues.text: Her clear heart.

dialogues.jp: 音夢と心重なった俺は覚えている。
dialogues.en: I remember how we made love.
dialogues.text: I remember how we made love.

dialogues.jp: それらを――忘れてやるべきなんだろう。
dialogues.en: I should forget all these for her.
dialogues.text: I should forget all these for her.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「買って来たよ〜」
dialogues.en: "Here you go."
dialogues.text: "Here you go."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おぅ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「？　お兄ちゃん、今、泣いてた？」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan, were you crying just now?"
dialogues.text: "Oniichan, were you crying just now?"

dialogues.jp: ニヤリと笑って肩をすくめる。
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.jp: 今はまだ、心に秘めていよう。
dialogues.en: I grinned and shrugged my shoulders.
dialogues.text: I grinned and shrugged my shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
忘れられるその時がくるまでは……この痛み続
ける心をもち続けよう。
dialogues.en: I should keep this in my heart.
dialogues.text: I should keep this in my heart.

dialogues.jp: だけど──。
dialogues.en: I need to live with this pain until the time comes.
dialogues.text: I need to live with this pain until the time comes.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「可愛いお嬢さんだねって、おまけしてもらっ
　ちゃったよ」
dialogues.en: "He gave me extra since I'm a cute girl."
dialogues.text: "He gave me extra since I'm a cute girl."

dialogues.jp: フタが閉まりきらないタッパを抱えて笑う。
dialogues.en: She smiled holding the pile of octopus balls.
dialogues.text: She smiled holding the pile of octopus balls.

dialogues.jp: 「世辞だ」
dialogues.en: "It's called flattery."
dialogues.text: "It's called flattery."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ふんだ。いいもん別にお兄ちゃんに可愛いな
　んて言われなくたって」
dialogues.en: "Shut up. I don't need to be called cute by you."
dialogues.text: "Shut up. I don't need to be called cute by you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……当たり前だ」
dialogues.en: "I know that......"
dialogues.text: "I know that......"

dialogues.jp: 胸を押さえて笑う。
dialogues.en: I smiled as I pressed on my chest.
dialogues.text: I smiled as I pressed on my chest.

dialogues.jp: 痛い痛い……。
dialogues.en: It hurts......
dialogues.text: It hurts......

dialogues.jp: 本当に。
dialogues.en: Really bad.
dialogues.text: Really bad.

dialogues.jp: 「かったりぃなぁ」
dialogues.en: "What a pain."
dialogues.text: "What a pain."

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢を諦める◆
dialogues.en: ◆Giving up Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Giving up Nemu◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢を諦める。それが正しい選択であることは
間違いなかった。
dialogues.en:
I have to give up Nemu. There was no doubt that that's the
correct choice I should make.
dialogues.text:
I have to give up Nemu. There was no doubt that that's the
correct choice I should make.

dialogues.jp:
だが、それでも俺は音夢のことが好きで、本来
の音夢も俺のことを愛していてくれた……そん
なふたりが望んだ形に戻りたかった。
dialogues.en:
But, I still love her, and Nemu felt the same way. I wanted
our relationship to go back to the way it was.
dialogues.text:
But, I still love her, and Nemu felt the same way. I wanted
our relationship to go back to the way it was.

dialogues.jp:
ただそれは、もう少しだけ、せめて一筋の光明
を見出せるまでは、俺の心に秘めておくべき想
いだ。
dialogues.en:
I need to keep that feeling to myself until I find a small
light of hope.
dialogues.text:
I need to keep that feeling to myself until I find a small
light of hope.
